objective: Correct the live busy-session confirmation window. For event event-0027a459-968d-4ccd-afc1-99dfd0df9444, plain codex resume attached while the authoritative session was inside a bounded tool call; the unique wake was accepted at the next safe message boundary just after the fixed 30-second deadline, causing a false UNCERTAIN result. Extend the bounded transport and helper deadlines coherently so the temporary frontend remains only until deterministic rollout acceptance during ordinary busy/reasoning periods, while preserving exact evidence, cleanup, and fail-closed timeout behavior.
relevant_context: The event was claimed at 17:37:51.892Z, timed out at the 30-second bound, and its exact message was accepted at the next safe boundary immediately afterward.
A confirmation deadline is a safety bound, not delivery evidence; only exact rollout records may confirm delivery.
The helper spawn timeout must exceed transport confirmation plus cleanup escalation bounds, or it can kill a valid proof attempt prematurely.
Busy output classified before acceptance still returns BUSY and retries only after a bound-rollout state change; UNCERTAIN remains non-replayable.
